title: Swifties, Take Note: This New Taylor Swift Calendar Is Already a No. 1 Amazon Bestseller
summary: The 14-time Grammy winner’s latest merch drop is already a bestseller, with three official calendars available for Swifties to hang all year long.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Swifties have no shortage of ways to celebrate Taylor Swift’s career. From limited-edition vinyl releases and Eras Tour collectibles to official merchandise drops, the singer’s fanbase continues to find new ways to showcase their fandom. Now, fans have another collectible to add to their shelves — or walls.

The Taylor Swift Official 2027 Calendar is already a No. 1 bestseller on Amazon, offering Swifties three different options featuring official photos of the superstar. The collection includes two standard wall calendars and one mini calendar, each featuring different images from Taylor Swift’s The Eras Tour, the highest-grossing concert tour of all time.

The calendars give fans another way to revisit the record-breaking tour, which celebrated Swift’s extensive catalog across 10 eras and became a defining moment in live music history.

NEW MERCH DROP

Taylor Swift 2027 (Hanging) Monthly Square Wall Calendar

$17.99

Buy Now on Amazon

A 12-inch by 12-inch calendar dated from January to December, with bonus September to December pages from 2026 to start your planning right away.

Filled with official Eras Tour photography, this 16-month wall calendar features a different full-color image each month alongside custom artwork. The 28-page calendar is printed on high-quality, bleed-resistant paper and includes bonus September through December 2026 planning pages before running through all of 2027. Measuring 12 x 12 inches when closed, it has already climbed to the No. 1 spot on Amazon’s best-seller list for wall calendars.

MINI CALENDAR

Taylor Swift 2027 (Hanging) Monthly Mini Wall Calendar 

$13.43 $17.99 25% off

preorder on amAZON

A mini Swiftie collectible with official photos from The Eras Tour.

Perfect for smaller spaces, this mini wall calendar features official Eras Tour photos in a compact format. It opens to 7 x 14 inches and includes monthly spreads from January through December 2027, plus bonus September through December 2026 mini calendars for early planning. Each month offers space to jot down appointments and reminders while highlighting major U.S. and worldwide holidays.

NEW COVER

Taylor Swift 2027 (Hanging) Monthly Square Wall Calendar – Plato Cover

Celebrate every era with a new Taylor Swift photo each month.

Featuring official photography, this full-size calendar includes 12 monthly spreads, bonus planning pages and room for appointments, birthdays and reminders. It’s a practical keepsake for any Swiftie.

The release comes as Swift continues to make history across the music industry. The 14-time Grammy Award winner is the first and only artist to win Album of the Year at the Grammy Awards four times and remains one of the most awarded artists in American Music Awards and Billboard Music Awards history. She was also named Billboard’s first-ever Woman of the Decade recipient and is the only artist to earn Billboard Woman of the Year twice.

Swift is also continuing her chart momentum. On the latest Billboard Adult Contemporary chart , the “Back to December” singer lands four songs in the top 10, with “The Fate of Ophelia” at No. 7, “Opalite” at No. 8, “I Knew It, I Knew You” at No. 9 and “Elizabeth Taylor” entering the top 10.

Designed for everyday use, the standard calendars measure 12 x 12 inches and open into a 24-inch wall display with monthly grids, major U.S. and worldwide holidays and a bonus mini-calendar page covering September through December of the previous year. The redesigned mini-edition measures only 7 x 7 inches.
